blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) is willing to sit down again and discuss with social media company Meta how they can jointly protect children, continuous failure to arrive at an agreement may lead to cases, Secretary Henry Aguda said. Aguda, in a press briefing at the Batasang Pambansa complex, said that they have already discussed with Meta — owner and operator of social media sites Facebook, Instagram, Threads and messaging apps Messenger and Whatsapp — measures to keep children safe from possible harm.
